_note: COST-MODEL VALIDATION on the apr6 15:05-15:35 decoded window at time_scale=2.0 -- the same held-out eval window and load point as specs/c64/eval_ts2/apr6.json, so measured components are collected under exactly the conditions that produced the paper's eval numbers. Single policy (gorgo-2d, the paper's frozen weights rtt=0.276 queue=0.5, prefill_rate=queue_rate=1.0) because this run validates the cost model's per-component predictions, not policy ranking -- baselines contribute nothing here and would cost 4x the GPUs. Requires the engine fleet to be launched with REQUEST_TIMING_LOG=1 so each replica emits its per-request scheduler timings (queue_time, forward_entry_time, prefill_finished_time) joined to proxy trace rows by rid. Predictions for OTHER parameterizations (physical rates, weights=1) are recomputed offline from the per-candidate features already in requests.jsonl, so no extra run is needed for them. 3 engines/region-set = 1 L40S:2 per region.
